Batch: JoeWare DNSSrvRec, ELDLL and ELDLLEx source review plus exact-source acquisition retry

Scope.AdFindAcceptance: Excluded from selected acceptance batches; not selected or contacted in this source/acquisition run.

Findings: Publisher describes DNSSrvRec as a command-line tool to clear, replace, delete, or add DNS SRV records; page version 1.00.00 dated 2005-01-15.
Publisher page lists Windows 2000, Server 2003 and XP; it states no local security requirements and no source code availability.

Sources.Finding: Usage allows clear, replace, delete, and add SRV-record operations. Its banner reads AddSrvRec V01.00.00cpp, January 2006, differing from the product page's 2005 date and requiring artifact-level reconciliation before version assignment.

Findings: ELDLL supplies message/resource data for custom event-log descriptions and includes an installer EXE plus DLL; publisher page version 1.00.0 dated 2002-02-17.
Publisher says administrator rights are required to install/register; page platform list ends at Windows XP and says source code is unavailable.
ELDLLEx splits event categories and messages across two DLLs so lower message IDs can be used; publisher page identifies version 1.00.0 dated 2002-02-17.
Publisher says administrator rights are required to install/register; page platform list ends at Windows XP and source code is unavailable.

Sources.Finding: Usage includes an installer that adds/removes an event source and is headed ELDLLExInstall V01.00.00cpp, July 2004; it documents a use-as-you-wish freeware statement. This is a page/artifact date discrepancy, not a migration gate.

Findings: DNSSrvRec 01.00.00 dated 2006-01-15; publisher MD5 2d36802ffe70e3328e62dd3094123af2 and SHA-1 a25663bf9db368247aba79ef381830943932f1da.
ELDLLEx 01.00.00 dated 2002-02-17; publisher provides no MD5 or SHA-1 values in this row.
Sources.DigestBoundary: Publisher digest observations are not locally verified archive hashes.

AcquisitionAttempt.Result: Failed before versions.txt or any product page was fetched because the JoeWare hostname could not be resolved by the local shell.

Resolved: Product purpose, historical publisher-platform claims and date/version-list observations for DNSSrvRec, ELDLL and ELDLLEx.
Deferred: Exact archives, local SHA-256 and member inventories for these and previously reviewed JoeWare products.
Resolve DNSSrvRec and ELDLLEx date/version identity against exact artifacts.
Package lifecycle, exact recovery, synthetic behavior and Windows 11 acceptance.

Estimate.Adjustment: Unchanged; source review and a pre-transfer DNS failure establish neither artifact identity nor lifecycle/functional acceptance.
